purpose: Unify the remaining public Trust, byte-bound legal Privacy/Terms/Oferta shells, public Login and public Register under the canonical public navigation; use source-native RU/EN/ZH on mutable public surfaces and locale-aware legal chrome with an explicit canonical-language boundary on byte-bound legal sources; remove visitor-facing readiness/status/connection-state marketing from mutable public presentation while preserving registration, authentication, authorization, legal-source, consent and database authority unchanged.
effectiveAfter: This implementation scope becomes effective only after its governance manifest is independently reviewed and merged. The implementation branch must then be created or rematerialized from the current exact main after the preceding public phases; no implementation may be merged from the governance branch or from a stale base.
requiredInvariants: Only the explicitly listed public presentation, route-layout, localization, CSS, acceptance and scope-manifest paths may change. Registration/authentication endpoints, form clients, role assignment, tenant derivation, reviewer authority, protected cabinets, API contracts, database schema, release workflows and production topology are unchanged.

The canonical PublicSiteHeader is the shared visual shell for Trust, byte-bound legal Privacy/Terms/Oferta, public Login and public Register. This is presentation authority only and confers no registration, authentication, role, tenant or access authority.

The public Register page may change only chrome, navigation, locale continuity and responsive presentation. Existing verify and statusToken parsing, 512-character bounds, preservation across locale changes, RegisterFormClientPublic props and registration form behavior remain semantically identical. RegisterFormClient.tsx and RegisterFormClientPublic.tsx are outside this scope and byte-bound.

The public Login page may change only shell navigation, locale-preserving public destinations and presentation. LoginFormClient and authentication/session behavior are outside this scope and byte-bound.

apps/web/app/platform-v7/privacy/page.tsx and apps/web/app/platform-v7/terms/page.tsx are exact consent-evidence source artifacts and are outside the implementation allow-list. Their bytes and SHA-256 content hashes must remain unchanged. CURRENT_CONSENT_VERSION, CURRENT_CONSENT_EVIDENCE, registration/invitation client consent metadata and the PostgreSQL consent-evidence whitelist are unchanged.

The legal route layouts for Privacy and Terms may add canonical public header/navigation, responsive spacing, locale-aware public chrome and a clear governing-language notice. They may suppress legacy related-navigation/actions that advertise protected profile/auth/status surfaces, but they must not remove, rewrite, translate, reorder or visually hide any legal policy clause from the byte-bound page source.

The Oferta page source also remains unchanged in this slice. Its layout may unify public chrome and separate legacy operational-navigation cards from the public journey without rewriting the legal/service text. No operator name, INN, OGRN, address, contractual promise or other legal fact may be fabricated.

Because changing the hash-bound Terms or Privacy body would require a new consent version/hash and registration evidence update, EN/ZH legal routes must not pretend that the canonical policy text was translated or re-versioned. They may localize navigation and explanatory shell only and must state that the exact canonical legal text below remains the versioned Russian source artifact. A full translated legal-policy revision is outside this scope unless separately authorized together with consent evidence.

Privacy/Terms/Oferta public chrome must not advertise protected profile/auth/bank surfaces or a public status/readiness page. Public shell links may point only to appropriate public destinations such as Home, About, How it works, Trust, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Oferta, Login and Register while protected routes remain protected.

Trust retains and strengthens the existing no-fabrication, authority, evidence, role-isolation, external-source and Gekta boundaries. Visitor copy must describe source, basis, authority, action and evidence rather than live/active/connected/verified/pending/ready/synced/maturity or similar public state marketing.

External systems, banks, government systems, EDI, laboratories, providers, partners, certifications, SLA, geography, scale, customers and economic effects are never claimed without their own authoritative evidence. Platform capability is not evidence that an external system performed an action.

RU, EN and ZH are source-native on Trust, public Login and public Register, and locale-safe on every legal-shell route. The active locale is preserved through public navigation and Login/Register actions. Registration locale changes preserve verify and statusToken query values exactly as today.

Mobile is accepted separately rather than as a compressed desktop layout. At 320, 375, 390, 430, 768, 1280 and 1440 CSS pixels there is no horizontal clipping or hidden overflow, the full brand remains legible where the canonical header requires it, and interactive controls remain at least 44 CSS pixels in the applicable touch dimension.

Browser acceptance must exercise the full Cartesian public matrix rather than a two-viewport shortcut: RU, EN and ZH at 320, 375, 390, 430, 768, 1280 and 1440 CSS pixels for the homepage and every linked public surface covered by the final public journey, including About, How it works, AI/Gekta, Trust, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Oferta, Login and Register. For byte-bound legal pages, acceptance checks locale-safe shell/disclosure and unchanged canonical legal content rather than fabricating translated policy text.

The pre-merge Design System v8 browser matrix must include the changed linked-shell acceptance through an already matched Playwright spec; platform-v7-strategic-home-v3.spec.ts may be extended for this purpose without weakening its homepage, accessibility, no-overflow, role-isolation or registration assertions.

Keyboard navigation, focus visibility, skip links, reduced-motion behavior where present, forced-colour resilience and semantic heading/landmark order are preserved or strengthened; no accessibility assertion may be weakened merely to pass.
No new recurring cost is introduced and production remains REG.RU-only. No REG.RU deployment or immutable release action is authorized by this implementation scope.

Every implementation exact head requires terminal substantive CI, genuine independent exact-head review, no unresolved current review threads, final base/head drift verification and SHA-bound merge discipline before merge. Owner self-audit and machine analyzers do not substitute for independent review.
